capture_source: live capture 2026-11-25: the reference client (pyrfc 3.3.1 on the NW RFC SDK 7.50) calling Z_SAPRFCLIB_BCD_SIGNS, a purpose-built remote-enabled function module (local object, kernel 793). EV_VAL is typed DMBTR, packed decimal 23 digits with 2 decimals, 12 bytes. Cases P, N, I and D set it through ABAP (PACK, arithmetic, CLEAR, a SELECT from SFLIGHT); the other cases write the bytes directly, each with a different sign nibble, to see what reaches the wire and how the reference client reads it.
evidence: tier 1 live capture. 'hex' is the EV_VAL value as the server sent it, 'value' what the reference client returned for it. The server passes every nibble through unchanged; ABAP itself produced only 0x0C and 0x0D.
